name: agent-readiness-check
title: Agent readiness check
description: Checks how easy a website is for AI agents to read and use: robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, Markdown, structured data, trust pages and MCP discovery. Gives a score out of 100 with a fix for each failed check.
